content: Customer Vivaan called about his expired travel policy and requested a new quote. He asked about trip cancellation coverage for medical emergencies and whether his hypertension would affect the premium. Agent Neha confirmed the expiration, offered a new quote, pulled up the details, and agreed to provide clarification on the coverage and premium impact.

action_items: Agent to send detailed quote with trip cancellation coverage information
Agent to confirm whether hypertension affects the premium
Customer to review the new quote
